children.name: Create a test file in the Pictures folder with the extension .alsdkcs. Opening that file will launch this app.
This sample sets the DesiredView to "useLess", which suggests to the system that this app should use a smaller portion of the screen and leave more of the screen for other apps.

Create a test file in the Pictures folder with no file extension. This app has registered to handle FileType=*, so it will be listed as an option to open that file. It will also appear in the "Open With" dialog for other file types (but not as a recommended option).
